name: derealization
source:
Her name is Adele.
After the incident, she begins to see a visitor from another world and is admitted to a psychiatric hospital. The doctors are convinced she suffers from hallucinations. The fragments of her consciousness are shattered into pieces. They diagnose her with derealization.

His name is Onisiy.
Where he came from, there is only darkness. For the first time in his existence, this being sees light. Adele becomes a beacon for Onisiy, for she is the only one capable of seeing him. He does not know why he arrived in this world. Now Onisiy learns how it works and studies human society — and humans themselves.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4171070/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
她的名字叫阿黛尔。
事件发生后，她开始见到来自另一个世界的访客，并被送进精神病院。医生确信她患有幻觉。她的意识碎片四分五裂。他们诊断她患有现实解体。

他的名字叫奥尼西。
他来自的地方，只有黑暗。这是他存在以来第一次看到光。阿黛尔成为奥尼西的灯塔，因为她是唯一能够看到他的人。他不知道自己为何来到这个世界。现在，奥尼西了解了它是如何运作的，并研究了人类社会——以及人类本身。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4171070/]Steam[/url]]
